program: APPUI-01 - Detailed functional studies inside frozen Phase-1 architecture
question: Can causal/history inspection deepen from meaningful current material while preserving explicit current-versus-historical status, bounded disclosure, semantic origin and exact return without creating a permanent Archive/History mode or inventing consequence/replay/rollback semantics?
inherited_law: History is reached from meaningful current material rather than permanent top-level navigation.
Historical material must remain distinguishable from current Scene material at every depth.
Back/Close is navigation rather than Undo/replay/rollback.
Character-bounded/private disclosure must not leak through history inspection.
Causal provenance capacity may be reserved without freezing exhaustive causal-model semantics.
Light and Dark preserve one semantic system; no Stage successor is created.

design_result.entry_rule: A meaningful current question or other current material may open adjacent causal/history context; History is not a permanent app mode.
design_result.temporal_rule: Historical witnesses remain explicitly historical whether adjacent, selected or expanded as the primary investigation surface.
design_result.origin_rule: The current Production/Scene/question remains the semantic origin and exact return target throughout deeper history inspection.
design_result.return_rule: Close/Back restores the same current question, selection and focus origin without replay, rollback, undo or current-state rewrite.
design_result.causal_relevance_rule: The interface may explain why a historical witness is relevant without freezing an exhaustive causal graph, inference model, score or generated explanation authority.
design_result.disclosure_rule: Private/Character-bounded knowledge, claims, beliefs, memories, uncertainty and provenance remain bounded where Product authority supports them.
design_result.responsive_rule: wide current+adjacent-history coexistence -> medium history overlay/substitution -> narrow sequential current/cause/deeper-history; temporal status and return remain invariant.
design_result.theme_parity: PASS - Light/Dark preserve identical current/history and disclosure semantics

mechanical_preflight.environment: Microsoft Edge Chromium CDP; exact self-contained HTML; no external resources

first_visual_pass_findings: One historical-context sentence said opening a prior witness must not make it 'current truth', conflating temporal state with truth status.
corrections: Changed 'current truth' to 'current-state material' so a historical fact can remain true without being represented as current Scene state; reran the full browser/visual audit.

non_authority: Exact History/causal labels, chronology graphics, provenance field schemas and navigation commands remain provisional.
Exact consequence review, rollback, replay, branching, mutation and causal-inference semantics remain Product-defined.
Exact truth/claim/belief/memory/private-knowledge schema remains Product-defined; this study preserves only bounded inspection capacity.
Final typography, palette, materials, icons, specialized maps, motion and native WinUI behavior remain open.
No Stage visual successor, runtime/package/Store authority or native accessibility-device proof is created.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION - CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT
next: Detail truth/knowledge/disclosure inspection inside the frozen shell, preserving source/provenance and creator-global versus Character-bounded disclosure without inventing a final epistemic data model.
